descs.t: President Trump has called on Rep. Ilhan Omar to resign from Congress, saying she took the oath of office under a false name. The New York Post published a 1997 London marriage certificate for her sister that lists a father named Nur Said Elmi, and US Attorney Jeanine Pirro says Omar's real name is Ilhan Nur Said Elmi. We walk through the documents and what each side claims.

Ilhan Omar is facing a demand from President Trump that she forfeit her seat, after US Attorney Jeanine Pirro said her real name is Ilhan Nur Said Elmi. Legal expert Jonathan Turley says she might have violated federal election law if she was elected on false pretenses. We look at the certificate, the claims and whether Congress could actually act.

Ilhan Omar's story about who she is keeps running into her own family's paperwork. A 1997 marriage certificate published by the New York Post, Jeanine Pirro's claim about her real name and Pirro's financial investigation now sit behind President Trump's demand that she resign. We lay out every document and what it could cost her.

intro.plain: President Trump has gone to Speaker Johnson and said Ilhan Omar should give up her seat in Congress. His reason: he says she took the oath under a false name. The New York Post published a 1997 marriage certificate for her sister, and Jeanine Pirro says Omar's real name is Ilhan Nur Said Elmi. Chat, do you think Congress will actually move on this?
intro.mid: Ilhan Omar is in serious trouble today. Trump wants her out of Congress, Jeanine Pirro says her real name is Ilhan Nur Said Elmi, and Jonathan Turley says she might have broken federal election law if she was elected on false pretenses. The question is whether any of this can remove a sitting member. Chat, should the House expel her if the documents hold up?
intro.bold: This one is huge. The President of the United States is telling the Speaker that Ilhan Omar must resign. A US Attorney says her real name is Ilhan Nur Said Elmi, and the New York Post says a 1997 London marriage certificate points the same way. If this holds, it is a scandal Congress cannot ignore. Chat, prison, resignation or nothing?

hook.plain: A 1997 marriage certificate from London is now at the center of a demand from President Trump that Ilhan Omar resign. Here is what the document says and what has been claimed.
hook.mid: A US Attorney says Ilhan Omar's real name is Ilhan Nur Said Elmi. Trump says that means she must resign. Here is whether either claim can actually cost her the seat.
hook.bold: The President wants her gone, a US Attorney is investigating her, and her sister's marriage certificate just surfaced. Ilhan Omar's past is catching up with her, and here is every piece.

descs.t: Two IDF soldiers were killed in a terror attack by two Palestinian gunmen near Hebron, and both attackers were killed by Israeli forces. Prime Minister Netanyahu ordered a closure of the West Bank and says the army is on high alert for a large scale operation. We walk through the attack, the gunfight and what Israel says comes next.

After two IDF soldiers were killed near Hebron, Israel locked down the West Bank and says its forces will enter the neighborhoods the attackers came from. Netanyahu says he and Defense Minister Katz reviewed a plan for a large scale military operation. We look at the attack, the helmet camera footage and how the story was covered.

Two Palestinian terrorists opened fire near Hebron, killing two IDF soldiers, including 20 year old Sergeant Yuval Shay Svilem, before both were eliminated after a long gunfight. Now Netanyahu says Israel is prepared for a large scale operation in the West Bank. We show what happened, what Israel plans and what much of the media chose to focus on instead.

intro.plain: Two IDF soldiers were killed this morning near Hebron by two Palestinian gunmen, and both attackers were killed. Chat, do you think this turns into a full operation in the West Bank?

An Israeli who fought them says it took over 30 minutes to stop a much worse atrocity. Israel has locked down the West Bank and Netanyahu says a large scale operation is ready. Chat, should Israel go in hard?

descs.t: Two former senior FBI officials, Nikki Floris and Bradley Benavides, surrendered on arrest warrants after being charged with lying to Congress about their involvement in the Hunter Biden investigation. FBI Director Kash Patel and US Attorney Jeanine Pirro announced the charges. We walk through what each official is accused of and what happens next.

The Hunter Biden investigation has led to criminal charges against two former senior FBI officials, Nikki Floris and Bradley Benavides, accused of lying to Congress about their role. Kash Patel announced the arrests and Jeanine Pirro's office brought the case. We look at the charges and what they could expose about how the Bureau handled the probe.

Two former senior FBI officials are now charged with lying to Congress about the Bureau's role in the Hunter Biden investigation. Nikki Floris and Bradley Benavides surrendered this morning, and critics say not one Democrat in Congress has condemned what they are accused of. We lay out the charges, the officials and why this case matters for trust in the FBI.

intro.plain: Two former senior FBI officials, Nikki Floris and Bradley Benavides, surrendered this morning. They are charged with lying to Congress about their involvement in the Hunter Biden investigation, and Kash Patel and Jeanine Pirro announced the case. Let's go through what they are accused of. Chat, do you think more charges are coming?
intro.mid: This is a big one. Two former senior FBI officials are charged with lying to Congress about the Hunter Biden investigation, and they turned themselves in this morning. The question now is what the case reveals about how the Bureau handled Hunter Biden. Chat, should anyone higher up be worried?
intro.bold: Two former senior FBI officials are in custody today, charged with lying to Congress about the Hunter Biden investigation. For years people were told nothing was wrong at the Bureau. Now Kash Patel and Jeanine Pirro are bringing charges. Chat, is this the start of real accountability at the FBI, or just the first two?

hook.plain: Two former senior FBI officials surrendered this morning, charged with lying to Congress about the Hunter Biden investigation. Here is who they are and what they are accused of.

descs.t: Ethan Klein is accused online of cheating on his wife Hila with a 24 year old employee, and the reaction has spread far beyond his marriage. Many posts about the claim attack the couple for being Jewish and Zionist. We read what people are saying and separate the allegation from the abuse.

The cheating allegations against Ethan Klein turned into a pile on about Zionism within hours, with posts calling the couple Zionist freaks and accusing Hila of ethnic cleansing. Even some of his own critics say the reaction has gone too far. We look at how a celebrity marriage story became a test of online antisemitism.

Ethan Klein is accused of cheating on his wife, and the people who already hated him for being a Zionist jumped on it with slurs and calls for worse. One post said they hoped Hila gets cheated on too. We go through what was written and what it says about the people writing it.

intro.plain: Ethan Klein is trending today. Posts accuse him of cheating on his wife Hila with a 24 year old employee, and the reaction online has been brutal. A lot of it is not about the marriage at all, it is about the couple being Jewish and Zionist. Chat, should a cheating story ever become about someone's politics?
intro.mid: The Ethan Klein story is not really a cheating story anymore. The allegation landed and within hours the posts were about Zionists, the IDF and Hila's past. Even one longtime viewer said people are acting like it is the end of the world. Chat, is this about his marriage or about who he supports?
intro.bold: Ethan Klein is accused of cheating, and the online mob that already hated him for being a Zionist has gone completely mask off. Slurs, calls for his wife to suffer, and posts saying she took part in ethnic cleansing. This is what Jew hatred looks like when it thinks it has an excuse. Chat, are you surprised by any of this?

hook.plain: Ethan Klein is accused of cheating on his wife, and the reaction online has turned on the couple for being Jewish and Zionist. Here is what was said.

descs.t: Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a localized ceasefire in the occupied front line city of Oleshky, brokered by First Lady Melania Trump, the White House says. The pause is meant to let humanitarian aid in and civilians out of a city where about 24,000 people lived before the war. We walk through what was agreed and when it starts.

The White House says Melania Trump helped broker a ceasefire in Oleshky, a Russian occupied city in southern Ukraine, to allow aid and evacuations. Supporters call it a breakthrough while skeptics, pointing to Minsk II, warn Russia may not keep its word. We look at the deal and what it could mean for wider peace talks.

First Lady Melania Trump secured a ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in Oleshky, according to the White House, so aid can reach a trapped city and civilians can leave. Critics mocked the idea within hours, and Reuters and AP now report the deal. We show how it came together and what to watch as it begins.

intro.plain: The White House says Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a ceasefire in one city, Oleshky, and that First Lady Melania Trump brokered it. The idea is to get humanitarian aid in and let civilians evacuate from a trapped front line city. Let's look at what was agreed. Chat, do you think Russia will actually honor it?
intro.mid: A ceasefire in Oleshky, brokered by Melania Trump, according to the White House. It is small, one city, for aid and evacuations. But some people are already warning it is another Minsk II and Russia will not keep it. Chat, is this a real first step toward peace or a trap?
intro.bold: People laughed when Melania Trump's office said she was negotiating a ceasefire. Now the White House says Russia and Ukraine have agreed to one in Oleshky, so aid can get in and civilians can get out. Chat, give the First Lady her credit, or wait and see if Russia breaks it?

hook.plain: Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a ceasefire in the city of Oleshky, the White House says, brokered by Melania Trump. Here is what it covers and why it matters.
hook.mid: A ceasefire in one trapped city could be a first step, or a Russian trick. Here is what was agreed in Oleshky and what to watch.
hook.bold: They mocked the idea that Melania Trump could broker a ceasefire. The White House says she just did, in Oleshky. Here is how, and what happens next.
